cards.back: imperial examination system (select officials by exam)
cards.exampleTranslation: The Sui adopted the imperial examination system to select officials.
cards.breakdown: 科：用斗（斗）量谷物，分出等级 · 举：两只手（⺘）把东西举起来

cards.exampleTranslation: Use exams to select talented people.
cards.breakdown: 选：走（辶）到人群中挑出最好的 · 拔：用手（扌）把东西往上拔出来

cards.exampleTranslation: People with talent could become officials.

cards.example: 门第不高的人也可以做官。
cards.exampleTranslation: People of low social standing could also become officials.
cards.breakdown: 门：一扇大门，代表一个家族 · 第：竹简上排列的次序

cards.exampleTranslation: Yang Jian reunified China.
cards.breakdown: 统：丝线（纟）汇到一起 · 一：天下合为一体

cards.exampleTranslation: The Sui established its capital in Luoyang.

cards.back: to dig / excavate (a canal or tunnel)
cards.exampleTranslation: The Grand Canal was dug during the Sui.
cards.breakdown: 凿：用金属工具凿开石头

cards.example: 大运河从北京到杭州，全长1,794公里。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Grand Canal runs from Beijing to Hangzhou, 1,794 km long.
cards.breakdown: 运：走（辶）着搬运东西 · 河：水（氵）流过的地方

cards.example: 运河成为南北交通的大动脉。
cards.exampleTranslation: The canal became the great artery of north-south transport.
cards.breakdown: 脉：身体（月）里血液流动的通道

cards.example: 这是世界上最古老的运河。
cards.exampleTranslation: This is the oldest canal in the world.
The Sui's prosperity was short-lived.
cards.breakdown: 短：箭（矢）太短了，射不远 · 暂：车（车）停一会儿，只是暂时的

cards.example: 皇帝的腐化使隋走向灭亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor's corruption led the Sui to ruin.
cards.breakdown: 腐：府里的肉（肉）放太久，腐烂了

cards.example: 腐化和暴政使隋迅速灭亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: Corruption and tyranny quickly destroyed the Sui.
cards.breakdown: 暴：太阳下用力（力）对待，粗暴凶猛

cards.exampleTranslation: The Sui swiftly marched toward ruin.
In 907, the Tang empire perished.
cards.breakdown: 灭：一横压在火上面，把火压灭了 · 亡：一个人躲进角落，不见了

cards.exampleTranslation: The early Tang developed vigorously.
cards.breakdown: 蓬：草（艹）蓬蓬勃勃地长 · 勃：力量不断涌出

cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang economy was prosperous.
cards.breakdown: 繁：丝线（糸）交织出繁密的花纹 · 荣：树木在屋下（冖）蓬勃生长

cards.example: 唐朝是当时世界上最富庶的国家。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang was the richest and most populous country in the world.
cards.breakdown: 富：屋顶（宀）下有田地和口粮，家里很富 · 庶：广大的人民

cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang was a powerful and prosperous country.

cards.example: 唐打败了突厥，扩大了疆域。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang defeated the Turks and expanded its territory.
cards.breakdown: 疆：弓（弓）旁边的土地边界 · 域：一片有边界（或）的土（土）地

cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Taizong had great talent and bold strategy.

cards.back: to be good at / skilled in
cards.exampleTranslation: Taizong was good at listening to advice.
Taizong's governance was enlightened.

cards.back: the Prosperity of Zhenguan (Taizong's golden era)
cards.example: 唐太宗时期史称贞观之治。
cards.exampleTranslation: Taizong's era is known in history as the Prosperity of Zhenguan.

cards.back: Yang Jian — founder of the Sui dynasty (581)
cards.exampleTranslation: In 581, Yang Jian founded the Sui dynasty.

cards.back: Li Yuan — Emperor Gaozu, founder of the Tang dynasty (618)
cards.exampleTranslation: In 618, Li Yuan overthrew the Sui and founded the Tang.

cards.back: Emperor Taizong of Tang (Li Shimin) — one of China's greatest emperors
cards.example: 唐太宗李世民雄才大略。
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Taizong Li Shimin had great talent and bold strategy.

cards.back: Princess Wencheng — married to the Tibetan leader to strengthen friendship
cards.example: 唐太宗把文成公主嫁给吐蕃首领。
cards.exampleTranslation: Taizong married Princess Wencheng to the Tibetan leader.

cards.example: 唐太宗加强了唐蕃友好。
cards.exampleTranslation: Taizong strengthened Tang-Tibet friendship.

cards.back: ancient Turkic nomadic people in northern China
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang defeated the Turks.
